title: Poster study-area module

intent.message: The study area spans two river catchments shown on one map module.

claims.statement: The study area spans the two river catchments.

expected_design_characteristics: A map extent that stays readable from poster viewing distance
North arrow and scale bar present and unobstructed
High-contrast labels over a subdued basemap
The module aligned to the poster column grid with a clear block heading
known_failure_modes: A low-contrast basemap that hides boundaries and labels
Labels too small to read at poster distance
A missing scale bar or north arrow
